johannmigano: "You're late," said the corporal when Otto Johannmigano arrived on Day 5. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Otto Johannmigano found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
marksebastion: Gustav Marksebastio arrived at R-F5 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

The barrage caught Gustav Marksebastio in the open at R-F5. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. Gustav Marksebastio finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept.
Gustav Marksebastio is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger.
Gustav Marksebastio spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
